items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Daryl Sherman with me this morning

ctx.x: Daryl was interviewed via Zoom on June 11, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Daryl Sherman with me this morning, pianist and vocalist and owner of something that a lot of musicians would be envious of.
